title: Fairness-Guided DQN-Based TXOP Control for NR-U/Wi-Fi Coexistence
abstract: arXiv:2605.00457v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: New Radio operating in unlicensed spectrum (NR-U) and Wi-Fi employ different contention parameters and channel-occupancy durations, which can produce severe coexistence imbalance. This correspondence develops a fairness-guided deep Q-network (DQN) that adjusts the NR-U transmission opportunity (TXOP) using the observed per-node throughput ratio. Two reward designs, Q1 and Q2, expose complementary operating regimes. Q1 promotes strict per-node throughput balance, whereas Q2 admits a broader inter-radio-access-technology fairness region and rewards throughput improvement in an intermediate fairness band. The policies are compared with the default Third Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) listen-before-talk (LBT), an adapted multi-armed-bandit method, a utility-fairness-based tabular Q-learning comparator, and a default-referenced fixed-TXOP baseline. translated_title: 面向NR-U/Wi-Fi共存的公平性引导DQN传输机会（TXOP）控制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.00457v5 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：工作在非授权频谱的新空口（NR-U）与Wi-Fi采用不同的竞争参数和信道占用时长，这可能导致严重的共存失衡。本文提出一种公平性引导的深度Q网络（DQN）方法，利用观测到的每节点吞吐量比率来调整NR-U的传输机会（TXOP）。两种奖励设计Q1和Q2展现出互补的工作模式：Q1促进严格的每节点吞吐量均衡，而Q2允许更宽的无线接入技术间公平性区域，并在中等公平性区间对吞吐量提升给予奖励。这些策略与第三代合作伙伴计划（3GPP）默认的先听后说（LBT）机制、一种改进的多臂老虎机方法、一种基于效用公平性的表格型Q学习对比方法，以及一个以默认配置为参考的固定TXOP基线进行了比较。实验在四个优先级类别和非对称节点规模下报告了聚合……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种公平性引导的深度Q网络方法，通过根据每节点吞吐量比率动态调整NR-U的传输机会（TXOP）时长，有效改善NR-U与Wi-Fi在非授权频谱中共存的公平性与吞吐量性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a fairness-guided DQN that dynamically adjusts the NR-U transmission opportunity (TXOP) based on per-node throughput ratios, achieving improved fairness and throughput in NR-U/Wi-Fi coexistence on unlicensed spectrum.
